schools.name: School of Rural Health and Sanitation

departments.name: Department of Computer Science & Applications
departments.overview: Established in 1989. Offering AICTE approved MCA and advanced research in Machine Learning, Distributed Cloud Systems, and Rural IT Solutions.

departments.name: Department of Mathematics
departments.overview: Distinguished research department recognized with DST-FIST and UGC-SAP assistance specializing in control theory and neural dynamics.

departments.name: Department of Physics
departments.overview: Active in nanomaterials, renewable energy materials, crystal growth, and energy storage devices with major national research grants.

departments.name: Department of Chemistry
departments.overview: Specializes in green chemistry, polymer electrolytes, corrosion inhibitors, and natural product extraction with state-of-the-art instrumentation.

departments.name: Department of Agriculture
departments.overview: ICAR accredited 4-year undergraduate and doctoral degrees integrating natural farming, seed production, and rural agrarian fieldwork.

departments.name: Department of Rural Health & Sanitation
programmes_offered: Post Graduate Diploma in Sanitary Inspector Course
departments.overview: First institution in independent India to initiate professional Sanitary Inspector training in 1965, contributing thousands of public health officers.

departments.name: Department of Rural Development
departments.overview: The flagship soul of GRI. Pioneer in rural extension, participatory action research, Panchayati Raj training, and sustainable village development.

departments.name: Department of Rural Management
departments.overview: AICTE approved professional management degree blending corporate business analytics with cooperative management and rural entrepreneurship.

departments.name: Department of Education
departments.overview: NCTE approved teacher education department imparting value-based pedagogical skills aligned with NEP 2020 and Nai Talim basic education principles.

programmes.name: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
programmes.eligibility: Passed BCA / B.Sc. Computer Science / IT or B.Sc. / B.Com. / B.A. with Mathematics at 10+2 level or graduation level with min 50% marks (45% for reserved categories).

programmes.name: M.Sc. Computer Science
programmes.eligibility: B.Sc. Computer Science / IT / BCA with min 50% marks in major subject.

programmes.name: B.Sc. Computer Science
programmes.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 Higher Secondary with Mathematics / Business Mathematics / Computer Science.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Mathematics or Vocational Agriculture with 60% aggregate.

programmes.name: Diploma in Sanitary Inspector Course
programmes.eligibility: 10+2 Higher Secondary with Science (Biology / Physics / Chemistry / Botany / Zoology).

programmes.name: M.A. Rural Development
programmes.eligibility: Any Bachelor Degree from a recognized University with minimum 50% marks in aggregate.

programmes.name: MBA Rural Management
programmes.eligibility: Bachelor degree in any discipline with min 50% marks + CUET-PG / MAT / TANCET score.

programmes.name: ITEP 4-Year B.Ed. Integrated Programme
programmes.eligibility: 10+2 with 50% marks + National Common Entrance Test (NCET) conducted by NTA.

programmes.name: Ph.D. in Computer Science
programmes.eligibility: Master Degree in Computer Science / IT / MCA with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) + UGC NET/JRF or GRI Research Entrance Test (RET).

programmes.name: D.Sc. and D.Litt. Post Doctoral Fellowship
programmes.eligibility: Awarded Ph.D. degree with minimum 5 years post-doctoral research experience and high impact factor publications.

events.title: 38th Annual Convocation of The Gandhigram Rural Institute
events.organizer: Office of the Registrar & Controller of Examinations
events.description: Conferment of degrees and medals to graduate, postgraduate, and doctoral candidates by the Chancellor and Chief Guest.

events.title: Mahatma Gandhi 157th Jayanti & Nai Talim Exhibition
events.venue: Gandhian Heritage Pavilion & Open Air Theatre
events.organizer: Department of Rural Development & Gandhian Studies
events.description: Community spinning session (Sarvodaya Charkha prayer), all-religion prayer, and village handicrafts exhibition.

events.title: National Conference on Rural Digital Transformation & Unnat Bharat Abhiyan
events.organizer: Department of Computer Science & Unnat Bharat Abhiyan Cell
events.description: Deliberations on AI for rural healthcare, precision agriculture in rainfed drylands, and grassroots digital governance.

careers.title: Recruitment of Guest Faculty / Teaching Assistants in Computer Science
careers.qualification: Master degree in Computer Applications / Computer Science with min 55% marks and UGC-NET / SET / Ph.D.

careers.title: Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in DST-PURSE Nanomaterials Project
careers.department: Department of Chemistry & Centre for Nanoscience
careers.qualification: M.Sc. Chemistry / Materials Science with NET/GATE qualification. Fellowship: ₹37,000 + 16% HRA.

careers.title: Appointment of Technical Officer in Central Instrumentation Centre (CIC)
careers.qualification: M.Sc. / B.Tech in Instrumentation / Physics / Chemistry with 2 years operating experience in NMR / XRD instrumentation.

scholarships.name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) — Central Sector Scheme
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
scholarships.eligibility: Top 20th percentile in 10+2 board examinations with family income < ₹4.50 LPA enrolled in regular degree programme.

scholarships.name: UGC-NET Junior Research Fellowship (JRF)
scholarships.eligibility: UGC-NET / CSIR-NET JRF qualified candidates enrolled in full-time Ph.D. programme at GRI.

scholarships.name: Government of Tamil Nadu Post-Matric Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Dept, Govt of Tamil Nadu
scholarships.award_amount: Full Tuition Fee Waiver + Maintenance Allowance
scholarships.eligibility: Native SC/ST/SCC students studying in regular courses at GRI with family annual income < ₹2.50 LPA.

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati & Saksham Scholarship Scheme
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.eligibility: Girl students (Pragati) and differently abled students (Saksham) admitted to AICTE approved MCA / MBA courses.

facilities.name: Dr. G. Ramachandran Central Library
facilities.description: Central knowledge repository with 1,83,587 volumes, rare Gandhian collections, 149 periodicals, 1,452 doctoral theses, and National Digital Library (NDL) node.

facilities.name: GRI Central Computer Centre
facilities.description: Established in 1989, powers high-speed fiber campus networking via National Knowledge Network (NKN), student computer labs (60+ terminals), and cloud portal servers.

facilities.name: GRI Campus Health Centre
facilities.description: Dedicated healthcare facility providing outpatient medical treatment, 24/7 ambulance support, clinical diagnostics, and wellness consultations for all students and residents.

facilities.name: Central Instrumentation Centre (CIC)
facilities.description: State-of-the-art analytical instrumentation facility supporting researchers and industry in spectroscopy, crystal analysis, and materials characterization.

media_gallery.caption: Iconic administrative block established in 1956 overlooking the Sirumalai foothills.

video_gallery.description: Comprehensive historical documentary detailing the genesis of Gandhigram Rural Institute, founding pioneers Dr. T. S. Soundram & Dr. G. Ramachandran, and rural higher education.
